reviews.text: Thanks for everything

Personally, I was disappointed. I understand everything, but the prices are truly high. Let me start by saying that I'm no one to judge the work of others, let's be clear. I only paid because I care about my best friend's health. I appreciate the professionalism, but it would be desirable to act more conscientiously.

I've had the opportunity to meet the clinic's doctors on three occasions. In all three cases, they provided extremely professional support and advice for a variety of serious cases.

The first was my dog, who had a benign branching tumor in the anal muscle area. Dr. Piroli was able to intervene without damaging the muscle, allowing my 11-year-old large-breed dog to maintain his sphincter muscles. This is extremely important for a large, elderly dog.

A few years later, the dog developed a strange form of paralysis, and the clinic's doctors were able to refer me to an emergency center specializing in neurological diseases, where they treated my dog ​​for temporary peripheral nervous system paralysis. My dog ​​lived to be fourteen thanks to them, who supported me even in the final stages of his life.

The third case was my cat, who was admitted to another emergency clinic for stress-induced renal colic (the second of his life). He was bounced around by several doctors, some wanting to operate on him, others not. I decided to transfer him to the Cassia Di Notte clinic, where they supported me in every way, even emotionally, to make a decision. Finally, after days of hospitalization and medical monitoring, the cat made a full recovery without undergoing a highly invasive operation that would have compromised his quality of life due to urinary leakage. I just have to thank you for believing in us before I did.

I read some negative reviews, which I was genuinely surprised by, and while there may be cases and cases, doctors, as individuals and as clients, always have their own unique personalities. I want to say that the clinic's veterinary medical professionalism, which they have always shown us, is unquestionable. I wouldn't take my pets anywhere else.

Thank you so much.
Don't trust them! ZERO PROFESSIONALISM, ZERO!!!!!

I took my dog ​​for an ultrasound check on Saturday afternoon, since the dog had a catheterization on Friday morning (elsewhere) and by Saturday evening he still hadn't peed. I must say that they were very kind and after an examination, ultrasound and cortisone injection, I left without paying (because they didn't want it) and what they told me went well. So thank you.

I'm truly sorry I can't give it 5 stars. I don't question the doctors' skill; on the contrary, I've always had a great experience, especially with Dr. Piroli.

The clinic's downside is the truly exorbitant prices. Every single operation is a rip-off.
Never again in this clinic, they take advantage of animals, for the costs
We came around 1:30 AM for an emergency. We rang for half an hour without receiving an answer, even though the clinic claims to be always open. Terrible service.

I had an appointment this morning for my cat's ultrasound, after spending €500, I took half a day off work to come (even inconveniencing the cat for nothing) to be told that the shifts had changed, you could have let me know.

Dear user, we take every report very seriously, but we have cross-checked our medical and tax records and there are no clients or patients associated with this name. If there is an error or the card is registered to a different person, please contact the Health Department at 06 89821557 to clarify the incident. In the absence of a response, to protect our organization, we have forwarded the profile to Google for verification of possible inauthenticity.

I'm writing this review two years after the event that led me to this clinic, which I found on Google for a nighttime emergency. It was the closest one. I contacted them by phone before arriving, and they were kind. When I arrived, two doctors helped me with my dog's injured paw, as he weighed over 60 kg. They were thorough and very kind. They provided dressings, x-rays, and medications for home care, and a free check-up 15 days after the event. The prices? I actually expected much more. It's known that nighttime costs are higher, but honestly, nothing out of the ordinary compared to other clinics. I hope not, but if I ever need it, I would definitely return to this clinic for an emergency.

I took my Cavalier to the dog for a suspected foxtail in his ear at 10:00 PM.
Nighttime fee applied: emergency room visit €110.00 (in my opinion not necessary but mandatory); foxtail extraction €65.00.
Total bill €175.00.
... oh please!! Excessive cost!!
In any case, the vet on duty was impeccable and kind.

I took my dog ​​for a foxtail awn examination, and everyone was really kind to me and sweet to my puppy. The next day, another foxtail awn, another paw. The doctor didn't even charge me for the visit, since I'd had one the day before, but he was still kind to her and very professional with me, even giving me some advice on how to handle future similar episodes on my own.

Absolutely to be avoided, their only goal is to steal money for the (overpaid) visit compared to the others, inconclusive with 2 dogs with the same pathology, they gave them 2 different injections, paying 299.99 which is already laughable! And then they tell me we'll give you a quote to keep them under observation and find out what's wrong, at the modest sum of 600 euros per dog! I left without knowing what my dogs had, only to go to the hospital in Gregorio VII and discover that they had been bitten by something poisonous, be it a viper or something else! In any case, I don't recommend them, if you want to make your pets feel bad, take them to them, try it and believe it! And don't even try to say that I haven't been to your place because they really spit on you; in fact, ask around about them and see what other people and other vets say!

I went to this clinic with my dog ​​for surgery following a domestic accident and found an attentive, meticulous, and highly professional team that works as a team to solve real problems. Despite the somewhat high prices, you truly get an operating room with a surgeon, equipment, and medical instructions, just like with humans, and that costs money. Thank you for everything.

I had a decidedly disappointing experience. The fees charged seemed disproportionate to the complexity of the work and the overall quality of the service received. I didn't feel very transparent during the quote process, and I ended up with a much higher bill than I expected.

The turnaround time was also slow, and communication wasn't always clear, which made the experience even more frustrating. Considering the quality-price ratio, I don't consider the service competitive with other alternatives on the market.
Exorbitant prices, not commensurate with the services offered. For simple repairs, I've paid significantly above market prices. Not recommended if you're looking for fair rates.

Friendly and humane. Thank you for your help when my vet was closed; they quickly resolved my cat's problem.
Thanks again.

My experience at this clinic was extremely negative.
I went to them as an emergency for a suspected urinary stone in my cat and was shocked by the costs and the approach, which I perceived as excessively commercial.

For a simple visit that consisted of an abdominal palpation, I was charged €100. A catheter placement cost €450, while a few hours' stay in a small cage cost €140 per day. Overall, in just a few hours, I found myself having to pay almost €700.

Concerned both for the bill and for the animal's well-being, I decided to immediately collect the order and take it to my trusted veterinarian to avoid the worst.

This, unfortunately, was my experience: extremely high prices, little transparency, and the feeling (certainty) that profit came before the animal's care. I will never return!!

Let me start by saying that I'm talking about my personal experience with this clinic. It's true that I arrived with my little Fulga in a critical situation (again due to an incorrect diagnosis from another vet) which the clinic doctors had confirmed to me as soon as I arrived. Even though they gave her back to me when I received her, the doctor on duty obviously said she couldn't say whether or not it was the other vet's fault; so I arrived for treatment from them, after a few days of waiting to be seen by one of the many doctors in the clinic, I was told that the dog must first be taken under treatment and all the tests I had already had redone - where did it come from that in reality my little one had a very serious stomach problem and from there all hell began. I ask if it's a 24-hour clinic why do we have to wait another few days for a specialist doctor? She should be automatically taken into care immediately and given therapy since it is an emergency. In the meantime the "patient" as they call them gets worse or loses his life... basically on Thursday I was told that I have to leave my little one in storage as she is in a serious condition - obviously I am desperate and I trust and for 2 days I am grateful. To the nurse Ludovica who has a humanity rarely encountered, it seemed better to my little one.. over the weekend I strongly advise against going or leaving your loved ones in the clinic, practically my little one was in a collapse from all points of view dirty and conflicting information between what the doctor on duty and the nurse told me, you obviously try to ask for information about the therapy how and when it is done if she eats if she pees etc (information that they are obliged to give you without you asking) .. the worst thing was the last day of my little one's life - I heard the medical staff laughing and joking without any emergency they made me wait a long time before having my little one examined dirty with food and poop who was complaining like a Christian - obviously I had the doctor - his response not to tire her - my greatest anger with the doctor on duty did not give the possibility of dying with dignity at home next to the family who remained with the 💔 and when I went to pick up our little one not even a word of comfort, and a bill Total of €1150 for 4 days and a half. My question to the owners of the clinic is also for the staff who work there. If you see that one of our beloved family members (animals-patients) is dying, why don't you give them the opportunity to be close to their loved ones? You have no heart, you only think about how to extort money from us because we are willing to do anything to save our loved ones. In short, you never go to the clinic on weekends. Your animals are left alone in the kennel, God only knows when I receive treatment in the cold. I didn't see a blanket or a lamp near my Fulga, who also had hypoglycemia and was cold. Even when they called me, I was told that they tried to resuscitate her using them. My little girl always needed a light bulb and blanket, she was hypoglycemic! If you are not able to keep stocks, don't extort any more money, really give them a chance to live, not to mention that you are told to start the schedule you go to visit. One of the weekend nurses was very grumpy. and inhumane treats you only like an ATM and as if you were someone who doesn't understand anything from a medical point of view. My Fulga could live near us now; but due to errors and wrong and late diagnoses she is no longer here 💔I hope you experience at your own expense what you made us feel - there is a Karma.. doctor thank you 🙏🏻 for your written response as a diagnosis we were able to proceed legally to the doctor who treated Fulga for years.. however I only wrote true words and he should not feel offended and know how to accept the negative truths.. Fulga was hospitalized from Thursday evening to Monday morning and we spent well over € 1500, and he must have respect for us owners-parents of these wonderful souls!
A boatload of money for a small intestine removal operation and a dog played. Incompetent.

I read the reviews after taking my dog ​​to the emergency room on December 26th. I can only confirm all the positive comments. Other comments, however, criticize the costs. Considering it was a holiday, and therefore overtime for all the staff, I think I paid a fair price. Therefore, it deserves 5 stars. Thank you.

I'll start by saying I waited to write this review so it wouldn't be dictated by the emotions of the moment. I brought a cat to the clinic after picking her up from the street. My vet ran x-rays and tests and recommended I take her to this clinic because her situation was quite critical. The vet who examined her performed an initial ultrasound, which revealed a more than critical situation but specified that it would be best to have the exam performed by a specialist who would arrive at 7:30 PM. When I called that evening, they told me it would be best to stabilize the kitten and run other tests, oxygen, and other things before the exam... the end result: three days in the clinic—not the full amount of tests and therapies for a kitten who had no hope of survival, not even with surgery—for a total cost of €979 (I had already paid €200 to my vet for x-rays and blood tests). I won't go into the medical aspect because I'm not qualified to say anything... but if they had done the ultrasound right away... they would have earned at least €700 less. I'm sorry, but taking advantage of people's feelings is very unfair.

I brought my 13-year-old puppy with diabetes that reached almost 800, only to find out it was a decompensation due to an infection (pyometra). They took her back for hair, literally. After the diabetes, we had major surgery to remove her breasts because unfortunately a tumor had been discovered, and today we're done. Nala is in great shape and back to being the dog she was before.
I found excellent people who took care of Nala as if she were their own, and I will never stop thanking them all for giving me my life back, starting with the surgeon, Dr. Piroli, and all the girls who work at the clinic.
Thank you so much, I highly recommend her.

Excellent welcome
And excellent care
Excellent follow-up with them. Cookie the dog, 2 years old
New 2 months old
Available for appointments, especially for emergencies
Open 24/7

Avoid them like the plague, they just took a lot of money from me. Went to them for an emergency on a Saturday night.
Paid one thousand and seventy euros.
An operation on my cat.
And now for three weeks my vet has been treating me every day while I wait to be able to operate again.
I limit myself with words for obvious reasons.
No love, no passion for animals.
I was forced to give one star to post this, but they don't even deserve that.

If you have an emergency, go somewhere else. I took my dog ​​in at night for a probable tracheal prolapse. A 10-minute visit, a cortisone injection, and another anti-pathogenic drug. They sold me a bag of medications, telling me to take the dog home and monitor her; if her condition worsened, they might need to intubate her. I got home, and ten minutes later she died of a heart attack. The paperwork they gave me didn't even list the medications they injected. €200 between medications and a visit, only for the dog to die shortly thereafter. They didn't even answer the phone, even though they offer 24-hour service. Never again!!! Go somewhere else.
I'm updating my comment after the facility's response: first, the doctor waited about 15 minutes, and in the meantime, she gave me the medications to treat my dog ​​at home. If he had deemed hospitalization appropriate, he would not have prescribed this treatment and only told me, after I had paid for everything, these exact words: "If you feel more comfortable, you can leave her here for observation." Obviously, I preferred to take her home, also because no one told me she was dying. Secondly, I'm attaching a photo of the invoice I received, which absolutely does not indicate the treatment he was given. I'm not deleting anything; in fact, I'll make sure to inform as many people as possible of what happened to you. It's clear and evident, even from the many reviews I read, that you only work for money and not for the animal's well-being. No one will give me my little girl back, but I certainly won't make the mistake of putting another dog in your hands again.

Hello, good evening!

I'm so sorry—I mixed up the clinic addresses; we never contacted you. I'm trying to delete my negative review and sincerely apologize for the mistake.

My husband went to the clinic for an emergency. My dog ​​had a lump in his ear. Surgery without sedation cost 270 euros. I was rudely greeted at the checkup. I couldn't hold the puppy. The nurse immediately intervened. They asked me what type of antibiotic I had given him... they should have known. The doctor who examined him told me he's fine, but maybe it's best if he comes back so she can show it to the person who examined him. I don't know how he was before. An invoice not in my name, difficult to reverse. For a renowned clinic, it's worthless. They have no way of communicating.

Unfortunately, it was a terrible experience... they think about money and very little about the animals... they pressured me to pay and only then did they examine my cat... I paid a frightening amount for a service that elsewhere I would have paid much less than half... the lady at the cashier was truly insensitive, the doctor I must say more understandable but I will never go back there in my life... absolutely to be avoided

I've never written a negative review in my entire life. I left there 10 minutes ago, paying €106 for a blood sugar check, cardiac osculation, and temperature measurement. My 13-year-old diabetic puppy, suspected of hypoglycemia, actually turned out to be hyperglycemic and in a debilitated condition. I was immediately offered hospitalization, which I refused due to a lack of tact and empathy with the vet on duty. The sole purpose that appears to be there is to extort money from anyone who walks in. In the past, I must say I've always had a good experience (I have three dogs), and I've never spent a fortune, despite anesthesia involving the extraction of a foxtail, and on another occasion, an x-ray and slow-release antibiotics. I believe medicine is a form of mission, and veterinary medicine even more so, given that it treats completely defenseless creatures. Anyone who lacks love first and a sense of proportion second has done something wrong. This is the last time I'll use your facility. Best wishes.
Alessandro Spinelli

We took the dog to the emergency room at night. "The dog is fine, just has some joint pain, and he'll definitely be better tomorrow." A few hours later, he died. They bear a huge responsibility for our dog's death!

P.S. This fact occurred and is documented. I have no reason to falsify or lie.

The person who cared for my dog ​​led to his death through negligence and lack of examination.
We rushed my half-paralyzed dog to the emergency room in the middle of the night. The lady who received us, learning about his osteoarthritis, assured us it was just pain from the disease and his adult age. A half-paralyzed dog. She gave him a medication that most likely only made things worse, because within 10 hours my dog ​​deteriorated to the point that, when we rushed him a second time to a more specialized clinic, they told us his condition was too critical and there was nothing more they could do. Now I'll spend the rest of my days wondering if my dog ​​was still alive, had we taken him to a place where people know how to do their job. (And if they don't, they have the integrity to admit it and advise us to go somewhere else.)

Forget about animal lives, I wouldn't even trust a plant to those people.

Everything reported is true, I have in my possession the invoice that the lady issued (2025/706) along with the medicines with the recommendation: the painkillers that she had sold us because "the dog would be better with these". (Meloxidyl 1.5 mg/ml 10 ml)

I brought in a newborn kitten I found on the street in serious condition, thinking I was doing something good. They charged me €400 to "treat" him, and within three hours of being admitted, he died. Be wary of these "vets" who only act for money. And to think, my mother recommended it to me, and after what happened, she too will refuse to bring her animals.
I understand €50 for the service, but €400 seems like a real lack of sensitivity, something that would be appropriate for a veterinarian.
Update: They refunded me €200.

Terrible, even though years have passed... My cat is still traumatized by what was done to her.
Not to mention the various unnecessary things, biopsies, anesthesia, etc. when the cat had nothing, a bit of a cold...
The first diagnosis you gave me was BONE MARROW TUMOR, then I was told, "Well, she's an elderly cat, at least 13 years old... So she was only 3..."

They advised me to hospitalize the cat, okay, fine, the next day they told me the test machine they had wasn't working, so they preferred to send her to another clinic...
Puff! Bone marrow gone... But snail poisoning, tocoplasmosis, etc.

Yes, but let's take a guess. ..
I picked up the cat and brought her home...
Well, my cat wasn't complaining and had "tics" near her tail since birth... since all the initial symptoms were present... I took the cat back... So they decided to give her an injection...
The cat went crazy, started wandering around and, excuse me, spraying feces everywhere... To this day, I'm still having trouble getting her to defecate in peace.
Do you want to talk about the cost???
€1,400, pay in installments and get the rest right away...
My vet for an ultrasound checkup and to solve the problem... He asked me €25.
So, for me, it's not a bad thing.

I'll answer you here because I don't see any other way.

Yes, it's true, it's been 4 years... So she has some memories!

Well, after leaving your office for the feces problem, I had to consult a cat behaviorist... Since she was a devil, running around the house, meowing loudly and losing it everywhere.
But thanks again for your expertise

Bad experience. We took our Maltese Camilla to the emergency room on the evening of December 26th for a gait problem and tremors. The exam was quick and superficial, and they said, "The dog is old but fine, maybe it's just a partial seizure. Have her see a neurologist at the hospital." No sooner said than done, but after a couple of days, it was nothing more than a hernia that was causing her terrible pain, not only causing neck problems and therefore movement issues, but also causing arrhythmias. Pain medication and rest were prescribed, and Camilla is fine again!!! It's strange that the "doctor" didn't notice right away for €80. At least you gave us good advice on where to go for a proper checkup. It's a shame, because 24-hour service in the area would be very helpful.
Terrible experience

We had never been to this clinic before, and last night we arrived for an emergency cesarean section for my Schnauzer Souvenir. They welcomed us as if we were their clients, with great professionalism and kindness towards the little girl. …

On Saturday, August 17th, our 11-year-old mixed breed was mauled by a large German Shepherd, resulting in a tear on his back measuring over 10 cm in diameter, including skin and muscle. The initial veterinarian consulted declared himself …

I wanted to thank Dr. Piroli for the professional ethics he demonstrated towards my Yorkshire Terrier, Lillo. Indeed, throughout his medical treatment, Dr. Piroli provided us with highly professional advice, without taking advantage of the …

They gave me peace of mind and a dignified life for my dog. They've been with me for years. My dog ​​suffered from numerous seizures every day. After a lot of work and attention, he made a complete recovery! TRULY CARING AND HELPFUL.
THANK YOU

This clinic, in addition to offering a 24/7 service, has been a loyal customer since it opened and we have always found it a welcoming and professional place for our four-legged friends. The added value is the humanity even in the most painful moments. Infinite thanks to all the staff.

I went to the Cassia Clinic for a serious emergency (obviously in the middle of August) involving my cat, and I must admit I found a very professional environment, with just the right amount of empathy. Everyone was kind and patient, very …

Professional, meticulous, helpful, and welcoming.

After a nasty fall from the balcony, my kitten was taken in, operated on, and …

This clinic is a safe bet. They never rule anything out, they're professional and meticulous. I've been taking my dogs to them for years, and every time I know and see that they're doing everything they can, and in the best possible way. It …
